reading.title: Presentation to Prince George's County Council Park Place at Addison Road Metro

candidates.quote: Park Place at Addison Road Metro, located at 6301 Central Avenue in Capitol Heights, and directly adjacent to the Addison Road Metro Station along the Blue Line Corridor, will include 193 units of Class A affordable housing and 11,000 sq. ft. of retail space, anchored by a community serving bank (Bank of America).
